pages.title: Shoulder armor
pages.user_intent: Compare decorative shoulder pieces available as selectable purchases.
pages.unique_value: Show the exact shoulder option and its contents on each card; distinguish a single piece, pair and outfit. Link to the existing PDP selector without implying that every photographed piece is included.
pages.decision: Prepare a type-hub brief from current selectable options. Commercial intent, distinct designs and inventory policy still require review.
pages.url_note: New candidate path. The broader linked /collections/armor path has a different scope; do not redirect it to shoulders or award the same primary cluster automatically.

pages.title: Body and fashion harnesses
pages.user_intent: Compare a harness as an actual selectable garment, with clear contents.
query_exclusions: how to style a body harness
pages.unique_value: Identify the harness configuration and precise included pieces; distinguish full outfits from individual harness choices. Do not treat all belts or chokers as harnesses.
pages.decision: Prepare a narrow type-hub brief; verify fashion/costume intent before claiming the broad body-harness cluster.
pages.url_note: Reuse the existing linked slug harness. Architecture B2 harnesses was provisional. No second harnesses page or redirect is deployed by this proposal.

pages.title: Burning Man outfits
pages.user_intent: Select FEYA pieces for an event with accurate composition and ordering information.
query_exclusions: what to wear to burning man
festival outfits without specific event intent
pages.unique_value: A reviewed edit with specific suitability rationale, component choices and current production/shipping limits; no protective, weather or arrival guarantees.
pages.decision: Hold membership. A title-derived world label is a discovery hint only. Obtain product-scoped suitability evidence through the existing Product OS review.
pages.url_note: Prefer the existing linked burning-man-looks slug when the route is implemented. No live route or canonical-history evidence currently establishes burning-man-outfits as a replacement.

pages.title: The shop
pages.user_intent: Browse the FEYA catalog and narrow the choices.
pages.unique_value: Existing approved catalog, filters and product cards; future crawlable pagination in the same visual composition.
pages.decision: Preserve current visual structure and 243 product identities. Bind an existing or newly approved portfolio ID only through the normal registry workflow.

pages.title: How to choose pieces and a costume set
pages.user_intent: Understand exactly which pieces a selector option includes before ordering.
pages.unique_value: Use reviewed FEYA examples for a standalone piece, grouped option and full set; explain photograph versus selected contents and link back to the exact PDP.
pages.decision: Prepare a utility brief with current offer examples. Keyword Planner volume is not a prerequisite for this buyer-help page; use the existing utility-rationale exception and CQA review.
pages.url_note: Proposed route only; current admin collection planner remains the preparation surface.

next_research.decision: Split decorative shoulder-armor and fashion-harness commercial ownership; review ambiguous intent with search-result evidence. Volume alone cannot approve a page.

deferred_seed.reason: Require product-scoped material evidence; raw mixed leather/faux-leather text cannot establish vegan eligibility.

deferred_batches: Q01 until event-suitability membership is reviewed
Q03 until material evidence and type-owner decisions are available
next_research.owner_action_now: none; use existing evidence workflow after independent staging/provider prerequisites are ready

ownership_policy.spelling_aliases: armor and armour belong to one proposed cluster
ownership_policy.pdp_owner: specific design/product configuration intent on existing seo_page_id
ownership_policy.guide_owner: informational answer or justified buyer utility, never automatically generic commercial queries
ownership_policy.conflict_resolution: OSPM compares intent and scope, CPIM verifies product facts, CQA reviews. Existing approvals and protected winners are retained; merge/split requires explicit evidence and versioned changeset.
